cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to collect my things. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Saturday lunch buys the hallway. Your records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry the boxes.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices renewed key access, A3 assigns partial hallway access to lunch and A5 grants records plus conditional carrying help, exercising superior control over relational exchange.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 Sunday work causes A3 Saturday alternative; B4 lunch for both satisfies the personal-time term and causes A5 another shared-listening price.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs belongings and has work; B4 offers a meal for both, a plausible attempt to resolve the imposed terms.

heightening.evidence: B4 shared lunch buys records, then A5 trades carrying support for one more intimate activity with those records.

specificity.evidence: A1 spare key again and B2 own things establish a changed connection; A3 record location gives access concrete meaning.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 one record as price of carrying earns the ledger from B4 offered lunch; stock A3 phrase is wordy.
